title: Yoke git hooks
current: The installed hooks find yoke on PATH, then at ${XDG_BIN_HOME:-$HOME/.local/bin}/yoke. A computer without Yoke commits with one line naming the computer and the install command; CI and the merge-queue preflight re-run the authored-file checks. Hook messages never suggest --no-verify. The installed pre-commit hook warns about staged files with unstaged edits and enforces authored-file limits and byte budgets. Path claims and implementation-entry status are checked by tool guards, not git. CI repo contracts check generated blocks, harness wake claims and rendered agents. Refresh recognizes current hook contents or a matching install-record hash; uninstall removes hooks only when their contents match the recorded hash. Four hooks record the lane head after every HEAD move git announces: post-commit (commits, amends, rebase picks), post-merge (merges and pulls, fast-forward or not), post-rewrite (the end of a rebase) and post-checkout (branch switches and fast-forward rebases). Each exits 0 and names `yoke project snapshot sync --head-only` when recording fails; a git reset still needs that command.
